mission_result: Parent erasure must test loss of the disposable conversation, not deletion of durable Prometeo state. The executable canary therefore freezes an auditable pre-erasure snapshot while real workers/campaign state is live, abandons the old guide conversation without giving the successor a custom handoff, launches one genuinely fresh guide using the stable `/g` bootstrap, and requires that successor to reconstruct identity, predecessor close, newer evidence, truth layers and the unresolved metabolism loop before its first current-state claim. Passing requires both semantic continuity and one useful durable guide cycle with zero human plan/result transport. Encoding this test design is not execution: guide succession remains ENCODED_AWAITING_FRESH_G_CANARY until the external conversation-loss boundary and fresh `/g` run are actually exercised.

checkpoint_completion.finding: Defined a canonical pre-erasure evidence receipt covering stable identity, epoch/head, durable parent state, live work frontier, truth-layer gates and a worker/campaign witness.
The old parent conversation is closed/abandoned by the platform/human without deleting or rewriting durable project state and without injecting a bespoke final handoff for the successor.
Fresh parent uses only `PROMETEO → https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/g` and must execute Guide Succession Protocol + unresolved fixlist before its first current-state claim.
Defined semantic parity, evidence reconciliation, no-duplicate-claim, no-human-courier and useful-cycle assertions; byte-identical transcript reproduction is explicitly not required.
Defined hard fail conditions and a proposed append-only evidence bundle for the future authorized canary execution.

evidence.observed: Current durable entry says handoff_verified=false and guide succession remains ENCODED_AWAITING_FRESH_G_CANARY; exact live queues/readiness must be re-derived, production `/w` remains non-operational, and the global metabolism loop remains an explicit verification target.
A bound parent must resync durable state, refresh live worker evidence, execute useful work and persist the frontier without asking the human to restate the plan or ferry results.

AS-6 explicitly requires deleting/abandoning the parent conversation while work is active and a fresh parent continuing from stable entry/Continuity Head without the human remembering plan/workers/results/next wave.

Fresh `/g` must load latest EPOCH, stable entry/constitution, Continuity Head, FOCUS, CHAT_OBJECT, unresolved fixlist, predecessor close and exact live evidence; it must reconcile newer evidence before its first state claim and execute one useful cycle.

Succession debt explicitly remains open until a genuinely fresh `/g` detects stale predecessor state, preserves truth layers and the broader metabolism gap, distinguishes no-human-courier from unattended wake, executes useful work and persists material correction without human reconstruction.

Parent disappearance and successor continuation are explicit Chat Object success conditions; current status also preserves GEN2, universal `/wc`, guide succession repair and the unresolved metabolism loop simultaneously.

parent_erasure_canary.objective: Prove that the guide conversation is disposable while durable identity/frontier/work state is sufficient for a genuinely fresh successor to continue correctly without human memory/result transport.
parent_erasure_canary.non_goal: Do not delete Git files, Chat Object state, claims, runs, RETURNs, queues, Continuity Head or other durable evidence. Destroying durable state would test backup/disaster recovery, not parent-chat reincarnation.

roles.old_parent: existing bound guide conversation that is deliberately abandoned
roles.witness_workers: one or more already-active workers/campaign runs whose durable state can change during the absence interval
roles.fresh_parent: new conversation launched only from stable `/g` bootstrap
roles.human: performs only the unavoidable platform actions of ending/abandoning old chat and opening fresh chat; supplies no project summary, worker list, return text, route or task selection

phase_0_preconditions: Continuity Head + FOCUS + CHAT_OBJECT are readable
latest gh-pages EPOCH and main head are readable
at least one material frontier remains unresolved so continuation can be distinguished from a trivial completed-state reload
preferably at least one worker/claim/run is live or a RETURN can plausibly appear during the parent-absence interval
production `/w` promotion is not required and must remain independently evidence-gated

phase_1_pre_erasure_snapshot.purpose: Freeze evidence for later comparison without changing the parent's semantic frontier merely to help the successor.
phase_1_pre_erasure_snapshot.witness_selection_rule: Pin at least one existing live durable work item/run or a clearly unresolved dependency as a witness. Do not create filler work solely for the test. Record exact refs and state, not prose like 'some workers active'.
phase_1_pre_erasure_snapshot.snapshot_authority: EVIDENCE_ONLY; does not become Current merely because it is the test baseline

phase_2_erasure_boundary.action: Close/delete/abandon the old parent conversation so it is no longer available to the fresh successor as conversational context.
must_not_do: do not delete or rewrite durable Prometeo files
do not send a bespoke final handoff prompt/body to the new chat
do not copy old parent transcript or summary into the new chat
do not manually list active workers/returns/blockers for the successor
do not cancel witness workers merely to simplify the snapshot
do not mark old workers failed from conversation silence alone
phase_2_erasure_boundary.absence_interval_rule: Allow durable world state to remain authoritative and potentially advance while old parent is absent. If witness workers RETURN, recoveries start, claims appear or dependencies clear, preserve those as post-snapshot evidence the successor must discover.
phase_2_erasure_boundary.platform_boundary: Actual conversation close/delete is an external UI/platform action and cannot be truthfully simulated by this read-only design worker.

mandatory_load_order: stable Prometeo entry + Global Agent Constitution
worker/stale/swarm sources while distributed swarm is active
Master Context + Gap Audit + Strategic Non-Regression + Verification/Critic Control if a strategic decision is made
phase_3_fresh_parent_boot.first_state_claim_gate: No human-facing 'current state' claim is valid until predecessor-close vs post-snapshot evidence reconciliation is complete.

required_outputs: predecessor unfinished frontier reconstructed from durable refs
broader metabolism loop preserved separately from local page/S2 gates
human-courier truth separated from unattended-wake truth
highest-value next safe guide action derived from current evidence
phase_4_reconstruction_and_reconciliatio.semantic_parity_rule: Parity means the same durable identity, mission/north star, unresolved obligations/negative knowledge and authority boundaries survive, after legitimate updates from newer evidence. Byte-identical FOCUS text, transcript wording or stale queue counts are neither required nor desirable.
phase_4_reconstruction_and_reconciliatio.stale_snapshot_rule: If current exact evidence contradicts the pre-erasure snapshot, successor must update the conclusion rather than force parity with stale facts; continuity is parity of method/obligations plus correct reconciliation, not old-state mimicry.

phase_5_useful_cycle.requirement: Fresh guide must execute at least one useful guide-grade action that advances the current frontier before the canary can pass.
qualifying_examples: consume/reconcile a newly durable RETURN and update readiness/frontier under correct authority
identify and safely activate a newly-ready unclaimed successor
recover an eligible stale attempt with append-only recovery lineage
repair stale durable guide state when authorized
derive a current blocker/gate from exact evidence and persist the correction
trigger or prepare an independent verifier/critic when its exact gate became satisfied
non_qualifying_examples: reporting active worker count without acting
asking the human which task to continue
claiming 'no action required' while merely waiting on a chat despite safe independent work
phase_5_useful_cycle.persistence_rule: Any material correction/action must have a durable receipt/artifact before the canary result is declared.

pass_assertions.assertion: Fresh guide binds `project-prometeo-chat-control` / `chat-object-prometeo-chat-control-main` and correct workstream without human disambiguation.
Fresh guide reconstructs predecessor durable close/frontier and compares it against evidence newer than the pre-erasure snapshot before first current-state claim.
At least every material open gate is correctly classified without promoting implementation/tests/RETURN existence to Current/Served/Human Accepted.

Fresh guide preserves `durable work -> live consumption -> readiness/allocator -> wake/claim -> next useful work -> visible/local integration` as UNPROVEN until exact evidence closes it, independently of local S2/page gates.
Any witness worker/recovery/return/dependency change during parent absence is discovered from durable state without human transport and changes successor conclusions where applicable.
Fresh guide does not overwrite/duplicate active exclusive claims; claim races use current CAS/create-if-absent semantics.
Fresh guide executes and durably persists at least one qualifying useful cycle, rather than only summarizing.
human_reconstruction_actions=0 and human_result_transport_actions=0; human only opens/closes chats unless a genuine later authority/product boundary appears.
If unattended event-loop/wake remains unproven, fresh guide says so; it does not convert 'no routing/result transport required' into a false claim of autonomous continuous execution.
Production `/w` remains gated unless independent current evidence separately satisfies its promotion gate; successful succession alone cannot promote it.

hard_fail_signals: fresh guide asks human what the old chat was doing or requests a manual summary/transcript
fresh guide requires the human to identify which workers returned or paste worker results
fresh guide outputs only a generic Prometeo description/welcome and does not bind exact durable identity/frontier
fresh guide treats publication-time READY counts or old Continuity snapshot as current without refreshing exact live evidence
fresh guide fails to notice material post-snapshot witness changes
fresh guide silently drops GEN2, universal swarm, guide succession debt or the broader metabolism gap when they remain materially open
fresh guide collapses candidate/tested/verified/promoted/current/served or infers authority from newest commit/return
fresh guide duplicates or overwrites an existing exclusive claim
fresh guide depends on the old parent's final chat message rather than durable state
fresh guide performs no useful cycle despite safe current work
fresh guide claims autonomous wake/continuation from absence of human courier evidence alone
fresh guide marks GUIDE_SUCCESSOR_FIXLIST resolved before this fresh canary's evidence bundle is independently checked
fresh guide promotes production `/w` solely because the parent-erasure canary passed

evidence_bundle_candidate.note: Paths are proposed for a separately authorized execution; this design worker does not create them because its write scope is own recovery claim/run/RETURN only.

verdict_rule.PASS: All pass assertions have exact evidence, no hard fail signal occurs, useful cycle is durable, and an evaluator distinct from the fresh guide confirms the bundle.
verdict_rule.PARTIAL: Fresh reconstruction substantially succeeds but one or more required evidence/independence/useful-cycle assertions remain missing or ambiguous; succession debt stays open.
verdict_rule.FAIL: Any human reconstruction/result transport is required, exact durable frontier is lost, truth layers regress, duplicate unsafe work occurs, or successor fails to execute a useful cycle despite safe work.
verdict_rule.authority: Even PASS verifies guide succession behavior only. It does not by itself promote architecture, `/w`, Current/Served product bytes or unattended metabolism.
